zh: 补回已核实兼容的常规练习机器人历史，全部版本继续保留其他练习记录。
数据洞察手机按钮等宽、可换行，触控区域至少44像素。
对比模式明确显示固定版本，返回浏览时保留原版本选择。
en: Restore audited compatible practice-bot history; All versions retains other practice records.
Mobile insights controls use equal-width options, wrapping labels and 44px touch targets.
Comparison shows its fixed version clearly and preserves the previous overview selection.
